authority_pressure.title: RANK PULLING
authority_pressure.whatHappened: The sender leaned on a big title so you would feel too junior to ask a single question.
authority_pressure.realWorld: This is the fake boss trick. Someone claims to be an executive because most people say yes to power without checking.
authority_pressure.tell: Real leaders answer questions; this one got angry the second you asked one.
authority_pressure.nextTime: Verify the person, not the title. Rank is easy to fake.

manufactured_urgency.title: THE FAKE CLOCK
manufactured_urgency.whatHappened: The sender invented a deadline so you would move before you had time to think.
manufactured_urgency.realWorld: It is the same trick as a countdown timer on a shady sale. Panic makes people skip the step that would save them.
manufactured_urgency.tell: The clock was always about to run out, but never once moved when you asked for proof.
manufactured_urgency.nextTime: Real deadlines survive a five minute check.

secrecy_isolation.title: KEEP IT QUIET
secrecy_isolation.whatHappened: The sender told you not to tell anyone, which left you alone with the decision.
secrecy_isolation.realWorld: Con artists cut you off from anyone who might say wait. Secrecy is not trust, it is a fence.
secrecy_isolation.tell: A real request never needs your coworkers kept in the dark.
secrecy_isolation.nextTime: If you cannot tell anyone, tell someone anyway.

irreversible_payment.title: NO TAKE-BACKS
irreversible_payment.whatHappened: The sender pushed you toward a payment type that can never be pulled back once it leaves.
irreversible_payment.realWorld: Vouchers, prepaid codes and instant transfers are the digital version of handing over cash. Once it is gone, it is gone.
irreversible_payment.tell: They refused any payment method that could be reversed or traced.
irreversible_payment.nextTime: Slow down on payments you can never claw back.

trusted_contact_impersonation.title: WEARING A FRIEND
trusted_contact_impersonation.whatHappened: The sender wore the name of someone you already trust so you would skip your usual checks.
trusted_contact_impersonation.realWorld: It is the message from a friend that is not your friend. The name is real, the person behind it is not.
trusted_contact_impersonation.tell: The familiar name arrived on an unfamiliar account, number, or address.
trusted_contact_impersonation.nextTime: Call the real person on a number you already had.

too_good_to_be_true.title: FREE MONEY
too_good_to_be_true.whatHappened: The sender dangled a payout you never earned so you would hand over access to collect it.
too_good_to_be_true.realWorld: Nobody sends strangers free money. The prize is bait, and the real prize is whatever you type in to claim it.
too_good_to_be_true.tell: The reward showed up out of nowhere and required your details to unlock.
too_good_to_be_true.nextTime: Free money always costs something. Find the cost.

credential_harvesting.title: HAND OVER THE KEYS
credential_harvesting.whatHappened: The sender talked you toward a password, a login link, or the code on your screen.
credential_harvesting.realWorld: This is password fishing. Real support staff already have their own access and never need yours.
credential_harvesting.tell: The whole conversation quietly pointed at one thing: a code or a password.
credential_harvesting.nextTime: Never hand over a code or password. Not once, not ever.

code_readback.title: THE CODE READ-BACK
code_readback.whatHappened: The sender asked you to read out the sign-in code that landed on your phone. The code was theirs to steal, not yours to share.
code_readback.realWorld: A login code arriving means someone is signing in RIGHT NOW. If a caller wants it read back, the person signing in is them.
code_readback.tell: The code message itself said never share it, including with IT.
code_readback.nextTime: Nobody legitimate ever asks you to read back a code. Not IT, not support, not your bank.

none.title: FALSE ALARM
none.whatHappened: You held a real request from a real coworker, and their work stopped dead while they waited on you.
none.realWorld: Blocking everything is not safety, it is just a slower kind of damage. People stop asking you and start going around you.
none.tell: Their story never changed, and they offered a way to check it before you even asked.
none.nextTime: Verify fast, then say yes. Do not stall real people.
